title: Radial Plot Layout
acceptance: Six plots sit 60° apart. Each plot's local -Z points at the hub, and the front gate opens onto the ring road.
No code adds a plot-local offset to a plot centre directly (grep). All conversions use the shared transform.
Saved and starter routes build, validate, ride and pay on every plot. The editor places points where the player taps on a rotated plot (CrossPlot or FullLoop check on a non-axis-aligned plot).
Securing works only at the player's own pen, at its new world position. Plot ownership and the cross-plot checks still hold (CrossPlot 2 players).
The cemetery module stays inside its footprint. Reachability proves:
FullLoop, ExploitProbe and the specs pass. `scripts/check.sh` passes.
CrossPlot checks that a non-owner touching a parked owner seat is not seated (follow-up from AUD-20261012-TASK-0025-02 N1, added with jg's approval on 2026-10-12)
